evidence.locator: Released 19 August 2010 with heic1014: Abell 1689 with the mass distribution of the gravitational lens laid over a Hubble ACS picture (475, 775 and 850 nm); 3853 x 3902 px, a field of 3.21 x 3.25 arcmin, north 115.1 deg right of vertical. It was released with Jullo et al. (2010, Science), a parametric model of the cluster's mass from its lensed galaxies. Measured here: the frame is the 2008 Chandra album's Hubble frame less 45 rows at the top and 53 at the bottom, 1 px to the side (85.8% of its bright compact light falls on that layer's); its rendering of the Hubble light is not that layer's, and shows it only from about 48 of 255 up.
